meta.title: 有这个拍照口诀还是轻松拿下！
meta.title_en: A Photo Mnemonic That Makes It Easy
meta.topic: 拍照口诀 · 机位与头位

scenes.context: 正面机位拍摄时，头部微微向下收，压出下颌线。语域：拍照口令，命令式引导。
sentences: 拍正脸，要低头。
For a front shot, lower your chin.
front shot（正面照）；lower your chin（低头）
低头能压出下颌线。
Lowering your chin defines your jawline.
defines your jawline（压出下颌线）
paraphrase: 低头 → lower your chin / tuck your chin in
lower chin · tuck chin
压出下颌线 → define the jawline / sharpen the jaw
define jawline · sharpen jaw
scenes.speak: For a front shot, lower your chin. Lowering your chin defines your jawline.

scenes.context: 侧面机位拍摄时，下巴向上抬，拉长颈部线条。语域：拍照口令，命令式引导。
sentences: 拍侧脸，要抬头。
For a profile shot, lift your chin.
profile shot（侧面照）；lift your chin（抬头）
抬头拉长颈部线条。
Lifting your chin lengthens your neck line.
lengthens the neck line（拉长颈部线条）
paraphrase: 抬头 → lift your chin / raise your head
lift chin · raise head
拉长线条 → lengthen the line / elongate
lengthen · elongate
scenes.speak: For a profile shot, lift your chin. Lifting your chin lengthens your neck line.

scenes.title_en: Back Shot: Flick Your Head Around
scenes.context: 背对镜头时甩头回眸，抓拍动态感。语域：拍照口令，动作引导。
sentences: 拍背面，要甩头。
For a back shot, flick your head around.
back shot（背面照）；flick your head（甩头）
甩头回眸，抓拍动态感。
Flick your head and glance back for a dynamic shot.
glance back（回眸）；dynamic（有动感的）
paraphrase: 甩头 → flick your head / toss your head
flick head · toss head
抓拍动态 → catch a dynamic moment / capture the motion
catch dynamic · capture motion
scenes.speak: For a back shot, flick your head around. Flick your head and glance back for a dynamic shot.

scenes.context: 身体拧转时配合歪头，形成对角线构图，避免呆板。语域：拍照口令，动作引导。
sentences: 拧着拍，要歪头。
For a twisted pose, tilt your head.
twisted pose（拧转姿势）；tilt your head（歪头）
歪头避免呆板。
Tilting your head keeps the shot from looking stiff.
keeps the shot lively（避免呆板）
paraphrase: 歪头 → tilt your head / cock your head
tilt head · cock head
避免呆板 → avoid stiffness / not look stiff
avoid stiffness · look stiff
scenes.speak: For a twisted pose, tilt your head. Tilting your head keeps the shot from looking stiff.

scenes.context: 仰拍机位时头部向前探出，缓解面部压缩感。语域：拍照口令，动作引导。
sentences: 仰着拍，要探头。
For a low-angle shot, lean your head forward.
low-angle shot（仰拍）；lean forward（向前探头）
探头让面部更自然。
Leaning forward makes your face look more natural.
more natural（更自然）
paraphrase: 探头 → lean your head forward / reach your head out
lean head forward · reach head out
更自然 → more natural / look relaxed
more natural · relaxed
scenes.speak: For a low-angle shot, lean your head forward. Leaning forward makes your face look more natural.

practice: For a front shot, lower your chin.
For a profile shot, lift your chin.
Flick your head around and glance back for a dynamic shot.
For a low-angle shot, lean your head forward.
pitfalls: For a front shot, raise your chin.
For a front shot, lower your chin to define your jawline.
正面机位是低头（lower your chin），抬头反而显脸大。
For a back shot, just stand still.
Flick your head around and glance back — it catches a dynamic moment.
背面照要点在「动」，甩头回眸才有生命力。
I tilt my head for every shot.
The head move depends on the camera angle: chin down, chin up, flick, tilt, or lean forward.
头位跟随机位：每个角度配的动作不同，不能一招打天下。
A low-angle shot always looks bad on me.
Lean your head forward to ease the face compression — it works for low-angle shots.
仰拍显脸大头小，探头可缓解面部压缩。
shifts: 用 front shot / profile shot / back shot 按机位区分拍照类型
用 lower chin（低头）、lift chin（抬头）、flick head（甩头）、tilt head（歪头）、lean forward（探头）细分
用 define the jawline（压出下颌线）、lengthen the neck line（拉长颈线）说清楚「为什么好看」
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：口诀内容为五组「机位+头位」口令，按画面确认。
